title: Perfect Donuts
description: Modpack optimized for Donut SMP content creators.
body:
Best Donut SMP Modpack for Creators (Donutsmp.net)

Step into Donut SMP with a modpack built specifically for content creators who want smooth gameplay, clean visuals, and minimal setup. This pack combines performance optimization, essential quality-of-life features, and subtle visual improvements to give you a streamlined experience for recording and streaming.

Every mod is carefully selected to remain fully SMP-safe, ensuring you stay within server rules while still benefiting from better FPS, stability, and usability. Whether you're building, PvPing, or grinding, the focus is on consistency and performance.

Key Features

Strong performance optimization for recording and streaming
Clean, creator-friendly visuals
Useful quality-of-life improvements
Built-in tools like voice chat and HUD enhancements
Fair-play focused with no cheats or unfair advantages

Lightweight and easy to install, this modpack is designed to get you playing and creating without unnecessary complexity.

Best for

YouTubers and streamers
Donut SMP players
PvP and survival-focused gameplay
Anyone looking for smoother, more polished Minecraft performance
